RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
Document: EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
Revision: Rev 7, effective 14/05/2012.
Steps
1. Run D-1 empty 5 min before charging (see WI-1997-02).
2. Pre-heat all epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1, 40 °C, 12 h.
3. Charge 430 kg liquid epoxy resin KO-Epox 410 LC (Kessler-Ondra).
4. Add 40 kg reactive diluent; mix 10 min.
5. Wait 20 min after diluent before viscosity sample.
6. Sieve quartz flour on 1 mm screen before charging.
7. Add 250 kg quartz flour and 20 kg micro-silica under vacuum (-0.8 bar).
8. Add 2.4 kg silicone defoamer.
9. Sample; EEW 190-210 g/eq.
10. Flush every pail with nitrogen before filling (FL-2).
11. Fill 20 kg pails on FL-2, close and label.
12. Store filled pails upside down 24 h (FT).
Change note
Resin changed to KO-Epox 410 LC (SQ-2012-007). Hot box step retained.
